name: Budigalimab
sort_evidence: NCT05822752 Phase 2 active not recruiting uses budigalimab, AbbVie's own unapproved anti-PD-1 antibody, as the partner to livmoniplimab; no book row or approval holds it.

trials.title: Study to Evaluate Adverse Events, and Change in Disease Activity, When Intravenously (IV) Infused With Livmoniplimab in Combination With IV Infused Budigalimab in Adult Participants With Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC)
